text:
maria: Heads-up — just tried a helm upgrade for gpupool-manager in us-west-2 and the post-upgrade hook job is hung. Job never completes, release is stuck in HOOKS_FAILED.

deploy-bot: helm upgrade gpupool-manager v2.3.1 -> status: FAILED (HOOKS_FAILED). Job: gpupool-manager-postupgrade-1 still pending.

ashok: Can you paste the pod/job status and any node events?

maria: Sure. Job pod is Terminating and stuck on volume detach: 
```
$ kubectl get pods -n infra | grep gpupool-manager-postupgrade
gpupool-manager-postupgrade-1-xyz  0/1 Terminating  1  12m
$ kubectl describe pod gpupool-manager-postupgrade-1-xyz -n infra
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning AttachVolume  11m   attachdetach-controller  AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "local-device-1" : failed to get device: node lost during attach
```

jess: FYI the cloud autoscaler kicked off a node-autorepair earlier for gpu-node-47 (OOM kubelet). It looks like the device plugin created a host-mounted volume /var/lib/gpu-hosts and left a finalizer on a CRD instance that the post-upgrade job expects to clean up. While the node was being replaced the job can't re-attach that host volume -> Terminating.

sam: Oof. If the hook job keeps failing Argo will detect drift and try to reapply the release, creating concurrent hook jobs. That's going to reduce available GPU capacity if we spawn more jobs on other nodes. Can we pause sync? @deploy-bot ?

deploy-bot: argo-app/gpupools sync: PAUSED by manual action (reason: helm hooks causing concurrent jobs).

kai: Short-term fix: remove the finalizer on the CRD instance that blocks volume cleanup, delete the stuck job/pod, then re-run the helm post-upgrade hook. Long-term: add a pre-upgrade check to detect node-autorepair in progress and bail.

ashok: Agreed. Can you paste the exact patch command? I want to review before we touch CRD finalizers.

maria: Running the patch now (one-liner we use for emergency finalizer removals):
```
kubectl get gpupool gpupool-usw2 -n infra -o json | jq '.metadata.finalizers = []' | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl delete job gpupool-manager-postupgrade-1 -n infra --grace-period=0 --force
```

maria: After that I did `helm upgrade --reuse-values --timeout 10m --wait gpupool-manager ./charts/gpupool` — post-upgrade hook re-ran and completed. Release moved to DEPLOYED.

deploy-bot: helm upgrade gpupool-manager -> SUCCESS. post-upgrade hook completed.

jess: Nice catch. We'll still need a safer approach: 1) add an Argo pre-sync hook that checks for node replacements/repairs, 2) make hooks idempotent and avoid hostPath PVs in hooks, 3) add alert when device-plugin finalizers persist >5m.

ashok: +1. Also open a postmortem for the failure mode so SRE and infra teams can align on runbooks.

maria: Opening issue and assigning to infra + releases. Will add a small change to the Helm release pipeline to pause Argo sync when hooks with hostPath-like volumes run. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks all — glad we didn't lose more capacity.
_meta: generated for dataset: helm upgrade hook stuck due to device-plugin finalizer and node-autorepair causing volume attach/detach failures
